comment: q14 r5 assembled-tile bench list (job.benches_from): rom_pipe exact at W 16 with RPH 1 + NDH 1 (soft leaves = the hardened leaves' logic), seams' mutants TMUT 5 (rpair) / BMUT 2 (node), TMUT 3, node boundary bench, NK boundary and die glue. Evidence: results/rtl/q14_tile_r5_1013/record.json. tile_die_glue_* apply to the KV die tile; an NK-only job may drop them. | q14-node: + r5_node_seam_bmut3 / r5_node_boundary_bmut3 (t_out feed-through seam mutant) after the node leaf gained the reset relay and the t_out/t_vout feed-through pin registers. | q14-node: the r5 gate runs carry RQR=1 (the submitted parent has the ROM return relay; latency_added 17).

benches.name: r5_rom_pipe_exact
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && python3 tools/rtl_qwen_me_partition_gate_w12.py --ref-file tools/qwen_blocks/ot_hdc_matvec_0e8df511.sv --jobs 8 --param GT=16 --param W=16 --param SMIN=3 --param SMAX=4 --param TCUT=3 --param BD=2 --param NWS=1 --param ORD=1 --param TWS=2 --param MEM_EXTRA=1 --param ACC_LAT=7 --param TREE_LAT=7 --param MUL_LAT=8 --param FAST_ISSUE=1 --param KV_PREP=4 --param ROM_PIPE=1 --param LRST=3 --param ARPB=1 --param MPR=1 --param HIER=2 --param ROM_CAP2=1 --param ROM_CAPX=2 --param ANR=1 --param ROM_ARELAY=2 --param HIER_HARD=1 --param TOREG=1 --param TIDR=1 --param LRR=1 --param XTX=2 --param RPH=1 --param NDH=1 --param RQR=1 --param SEED=1 --workdir {RUN}/bench/r5_rom_pipe_exact --result {RUN}/bench/r5_rom_pipe_exact.json; python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('{RUN}/bench/r5_rom_pipe_exact.json'));print(('PASS' if d['status']=='pass' else 'FAIL')+' rom_pipe '+d['verdict']+' | neg '+d['negative_control']);sys.exit(0 if d['status']=='pass' else 1)"
